paragraphs: A Land Rover AJ-V8 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ-V8 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ-V8-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover AJ-V8 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ-V8 is Jaguar Land Rover's second-generation V8 petrol engine, produced from 1998 to 2015. In Land Rover applications, it was fitted to the Range Rover Sport L320 in 4.0L, 4.2L (supercharged) and 4.4L (naturally aspirated) forms.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the AJ-V8?
faqLeft.a: The AJ-V8 was fitted to the Range Rover Sport L320 (2005–2013) across two main configurations: the 4.2 SC V8 and the 4.4 V8. It was also used in earlier Discovery models, but the L320 is the primary Land Rover application.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ-V8 differ between variants?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The naturally aspirated 4.4-litre and supercharged 4.2-litre variants differ significantly — the supercharger, ancillaries, and ECU mapping are all different. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is a supercharged AJ-V8 compatible with a naturally aspirated one?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A supercharged AJ-V8 from a Range Rover Sport isn't a drop-in match for a naturally aspirated version — the supercharger, ancillaries, and ECU mapping all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover AJ-V8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Naturally aspirated AJ-V8 rebuilds start from £4,500. Supercharged variants start from £5,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ-V8 rebuilds across both naturally aspirated and supercharged applications, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on supercharged AJ-V8 applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. The 4.2 SC V8 in the Range Rover Sport L320 is within our workshop capability, with supercharger components inspected and serviced as part of the rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover AJ-V8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ-V8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ-V8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the differences between naturally aspirated and supercharged variants — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
